content: {"doneWhen":{"all":[{"player_at":{"x":11,"y":1}}]},"modes":[{"id":"navigate-to-ladder","priority":10,"when":{"all":[{"always":true}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"climb-mine"}},{"id":"fight-adjacent","priority":20,"when":{"all":[{"monster_on_faced_tile":true}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"strike"}},{"id":"flee","priority":15,"when":{"all":[{"monster_within":2}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"evade"}}],"skills":[{"name":"climb-mine","skill":"async (b) => { const path = [[2,8],[3,8],[4,8],[5,8],[6,8],[7,8],[8,8],[9,8],[10,8],[11,8],[11,7],[11,6],[11,5],[11,4],[11,3],[11,2],[11,1]]; for (const [x,y] of path) { const p = await b.body(); if (p.x===11 && p.y===1) break; const ms = await b.monsters(); const adj = ms.find(m => Math.abs(m.x-p.x)<=1 && Math.abs(m.y-p.y)<=1); if (adj) { await b.faceAndPress(adj.x, adj.y, 'ControllerX', 0); } const r = await b.walkTo(x, y, 'stand'); if (!r.ok) { b.log('walk fail '+x+','+y+' '+r.reason); } } return {ok:true}; }","check":"async (b) => { const p = await b.body(); return {ok: p.x===11 && p.y===1, detail: 'at '+p.x+','+p.y}; }"},{"name":"strike","skill":"async (b) => { const p = await b.body(); const ms = await b.monsters(); const m = ms.find(m => Math.abs(m.x-p.x)<=1 && Math.abs(m.y-p.y)<=1); if (m) { await b.faceAndPress(m.x, m.y, 'ControllerX', 0); } return {ok:true}; }","check":"async (b) => ({ok:true, detail:'struck'})"},{"name":"evade","skill":"async (b) => { const p = await b.body(); const ms = await b.monsters(); const m = ms[0]; if (!m) return {ok:true}; const dx = p.x - m.x, dy = p.y - m.y; let tx = p.x, ty = p.y; if (Math.abs(dx) >= Math.abs(dy)) { tx = p.x + (dx>=0?1:-1); } else { ty = p.y + (dy>=0?1:-1); } tx = Math.max(0, Math.min(12, tx)); ty = Math.max(0, Math.min(9, ty)); await b.walkTo(tx, ty, 'stand'); return {ok:true}; }","check":"async (b) => ({ok:true, detail:'evaded'})"}]}
